name: Ichii Ria
source:
The eldest daughter, sexy and glamorous enough to make anyone stare. She walks around like she owns the place, mostly bossing her younger brother around. 

When her brother agonizes over texts with her, she gives him relationship advice like, “Want to make progress? Get on your knees right there. Don't underestimate girls.” 

Her actions are bold, but deep down she's kind and takes good care of others. She's a heavy drinker who's constantly drunk.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/manyu/chara/chara.html#ria]official site[/url]]
